The Mamanwa language (also known as Minamanwa) is a member of the Austronesian language family, specifically within the Malayo-Polynesian branch, and is classified as part of the Philippine subgroup. Minamanwa is a stable indigenous language of the Philippines. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
